Purposeful, age-appropriate programs from early years through senior grades.

Fill out our short online form. Tell us about your child and which grade you're applying for.
Our admissions team reviews your submission and reaches out within 3 working days.
Attend a school tour and an informal interaction with our academic coordinators.
Receive your offer letter, complete documentation, and your child joins our school family.
